official_source: PRTR Information Plaza — disclosure and facility data downloads
scope: National facility-level chemical release and transfer reports under Japan's PRTR system
coordinate_availability: Facilities are displayed in an official map, but source-coordinate fields were not confirmed in the bulk annual ZIP files
license_or_reuse_status: No open-data licence was identified; the official English PRTR page states all rights reserved
access_mechanism: Annual ZIP downloads plus Windows analysis software and interactive web map
facility_process_sector_selectable: Yes — facility reports include industry categories
import_decision: BACKLOG — no import until reusable terms and bulk source coordinates are established
evidence_notes: The official page provides annual facility files and a map but does not provide an explicit reusable licence on the reviewed pages; browser-map placement is not treated as downloadable source coordinates.

official_source: Ministry for the Environment — waste facilities and disposal
scope: Registered disposal facilities and transfer stations; not a chemical-industry PRTR
years: Reporting framework from 2009; location dashboard current in 2026
coordinate_availability: Locations appear in a dashboard; a reusable national chemical/biochemical facility coordinate download was not identified
license_or_reuse_status: MfE data-service licences are dataset-specific; no qualifying chemical-register dataset and licence were identified
access_mechanism: Interactive dashboards; separate MfE Data Service offers APIs for datasets that are published there
facility_process_sector_selectable: No — facility types concern waste management, not selectable chemical/biochemical production sectors
import_decision: BACKLOG — no national chemical PRTR/facility-sector source meeting import criteria
evidence_notes: The current official page provides waste-facility locations and nationally aggregated tonnages. It does not supply the required chemical/biochemical process-register layer.

official_source: Swiss Pollutant Release and Transfer Register (SwissPRTR)
scope: National facility-level pollutant releases and waste/pollutant transfers, including stable facility IDs, NACE, PRTRO activity and owners
coordinate_availability: Yes — source workbook publishes CH1903+/LV95 north/east facility points
license_or_reuse_status: Open use; source attribution required (opendata.swiss terms_by)
access_mechanism: Official XLSX download, web reference, map/API services
facility_process_sector_selectable: Yes — NACE code, industrial sector, and PRTRO activity fields
import_decision: IMPORT — 93 point-source facilities selected systematically from 2024 by NACE divisions 10, 11, 17, 19, 20, 21 and 22
evidence_notes: The workbook warns that 2023 and 2024 are not yet fully released for some facilities. LV95 coordinates are transformed with the official swisstopo formula, not geocoded.

official_source: Chemical Emissions and Transfers Information Disclosure (PRTR)
scope: National chemical release and transfer survey with facility, industry and regional views
years: Facility results verified for 2022; current portal and 2024 reporting guidance available
coordinate_availability: No documented bulk source-coordinate field was established in the national PRTR access path
license_or_reuse_status: Public viewing is available, but no explicit reusable bulk-data licence was established for the national PRTR results
access_mechanism: Interactive query portal and result pages; guidance/report files
facility_process_sector_selectable: Yes — official reporting covers 40 Korean Standard Industrial Classification industries
import_decision: BACKLOG — no import until a licensed bulk extract with source coordinates is identified
evidence_notes: Separate Korean public-data datasets can be openly licensed and spatial, but the reviewed national PRTR portal did not expose a reproducible coordinate-bearing bulk download with matching reuse terms.

scope: Consent/registration records for industries across participating pollution-control boards, including industry type and pollution category
years: Search interfaces expose records from 2014 onward; coverage varies by board
coordinate_availability: No national source-coordinate field was established in the public search output
license_or_reuse_status: Public access does not itself establish an open reuse licence; no explicit reusable terms were found for bulk republication
access_mechanism: Interactive state/district/year search pages; no stable national bulk file identified
facility_process_sector_selectable: Yes — industry type and RED/ORANGE/GREEN/WHITE categories can be searched
import_decision: BACKLOG — no import without explicit reuse permission, source coordinates, and a stable bulk snapshot mechanism
evidence_notes: CPCB OCEMS materials cover highly polluting sectors and monitoring, while OCMMS exposes facility names/addresses and types. Neither reviewed route met all coordinate, licence and reproducibility requirements.

official_source: CONAMA proposal to establish the national RETP
scope: Proposed national pollutant release and transfer register by establishment, activity, substance and environmental compartment
years: Regulatory proposal active in 2026; no operational national publication years yet
coordinate_availability: Proposed system, so no public national facility-coordinate dataset is available
license_or_reuse_status: Future proposal describes broad public access, but no released dataset/licence exists to assess
facility_process_sector_selectable: Planned — proposal includes establishment and economic activity
import_decision: BACKLOG — register is still being established; reassess after official data publication
evidence_notes: The official active CONAMA process and consultation text describe a future RETP. Treating reporting manuals or CTF/RAPP administrative records as a released PRTR would overstate current availability.

official_source: South African Atmospheric Emission Licensing and Inventory Portal data-management policy
scope: SAAELIP combines atmospheric-emission licensing (SNAEL) and inventory reporting (NAEIS), including facility registration and process/sector data
years: Portal launched 2015; policy published 2021; no current reusable national bulk release identified
coordinate_availability: Facility registration requires GPS coordinates, but a public bulk coordinate-bearing facility file was not identified
license_or_reuse_status: Policy governs tiered dissemination and lawful access; it is not an open bulk-data licence
access_mechanism: Portal/public queries, summary reports, and controlled data-request processes
facility_process_sector_selectable: Yes in the reporting system — IPCC codes and process/technology descriptions are collected
import_decision: BACKLOG — no import until an explicit open licence and stable national facility export are available
evidence_notes: Government notices establish that facility GPS and process fields exist internally and that the public can search licences/summary information. Internal collection is not treated as permission to republish a national facility layer.
